items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026, sent by a social-insurance body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 25.05.2026 (this day does not shift for a public holiday under social-law delivery rules, even though it is Pfingstmontag). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month objection period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day, 26.05.2026, and ends one month later, on Thu 25.06.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). That day is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: First direct debit of monthly contribution (June 2026)
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Voluntary membership and the assessed contributions start 01.06.2026. The letter states contributions for a given month are collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so the first collection (for June 2026) falls on 15.07.2026, a Wednesday; no weekend/holiday shift is needed as this is a routine SEPA collection date, not a statutory deadline.

warnings: This first payment date (15.07.2026) is only the earliest of an ongoing monthly direct debit of 530,85 € (412,65 € health + 118,20 € nursing care), collected automatically on the 15th of each following month — make sure the account has sufficient funds each month, this item is not repeated for later months.
